blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in multi-turn agentic workloads that require sustained interaction with complex environments. Existing reflective prompt optimizers such as GEPA learn from failed rollouts, but agentic failures can also come from prompt weaknesses, harness limitations, stochastic execution, or noisy judges. We argue that such failures may not provide useful learning signal, and may even be harmful; and thus it is essential to curate which tasks are provided to the prompt optimizer for better performance. We introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework that augments the prompt optimizer to select which agent experiences should shape prompt optimization. In particular, GEPA-Curator consists of two components: task curation, which filters out tasks that are likely to provide noisy or unreliable learning signals, and prior success retrieval, which selectively retrieves past successful trajectories for a task and provides them as additional context to the prompt optimizer. We evaluate GEPA-Curator on GoBrowse, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and $τ$-bench, using both Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of both baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA and 21.2% over ACE.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLMs)越来越多地用于需要与复杂环境持续互动的多回合代理工作量. GEPA等已有的反思性即时优化器从失败推出中吸取了教训,但代理性失败也可能来自于即时的弱点,被利用的限制,被花言巧语地处决,或者被吵得法官们. 我们认为,这种失败可能无法提供有益的学习信号,甚至可能有害;因此,必须管理向迅速优化者提供哪些任务,以提高业绩。 我们引入了GEPA-Curator(GEPA-Curator),这个框架可以增强即时优化器来选择哪些代理经验应该形成即时优化. 特别是,GEPA-Curator由两个部分组成:任务校正,它过滤出可能提供吵闹或不可靠的学习信号的任务,以及之前的成功检索,它有选择地为某项任务取回过去的成功轨迹,并作为即时优化器的额外上下文提供. 我们评价GoBrowse、ALFWorld、AppWorld的GEPA-Curator和$-bench,使用双子座3.1 Pro和克洛德·奥普斯5作为优化模型。 GEPA-Cureator匹配或超过两个基线的平均性能,收益率比GEPA最高为20.7%,比ACE最高为21.2%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
As interest in recursive self-improvement (RSI) grows, a central question is how agents can reliably learn from their own experience to improve future behavior ( Favaro and Clark, 2026 ) .
Reflective prompt optimization, where an agent acts with tools in an environment and a Reflector uses the resulting trajectory or end state to identify lessons and revise the agent’s prompt, offers one practical mechanism for this form of self-improvement ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
The revised prompt is then used on subsequent tasks, creating a feedback loop in which experience can progressively improve agent behavior.
In agentic settings, this approach rests on the assumption that experience from previously attempted tasks contains signal and information that generalize to future tasks.
blocks.zh:
随着对递归自我改善(RSI)的兴趣不断增长,一个中心问题是特工们如何能够可靠地学习自己的经验来改进未来的行为(Favaro and Clark, 2026).
反射即时优化(Agrawal等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年)。
修改后的提示随后用于后续任务,从而形成一个反馈循环,其中经验可以逐步改善代理行为.
在代理设置中,这种方法基于这样的假设,即以前尝试的任务的经验包含通向未来任务的信号和信息.

blocks.en:
However, it is often difficult for the Reflector to correctly attribute the cause of a failure to the prompt.
In agentic tasks, execution is mediated by a harness interacting with an external environment, and success is often assessed by LLM-as-a-judge ( Zheng et al., 2023 ) .
A failed rollout may therefore reveal a genuine prompt weakness, but it may also arise from external factors such as unavailability of needed tools, harness limitations, or even noise from execution or evaluation environments.
This problem is further exacerbated in real-world settings, where tasks themselves may be ambiguous or infeasible, introducing additional noisy signals to the Reflector.
When revising the prompt, the Reflector may nevertheless treat these potentially noisy observations as valid learning signals for prompt optimization ( Kirichenko et al., 2025 ) , causing it to misattribute the associated failures to prompt deficiencies, thereby producing unnecessary or harmful updates.
blocks.zh:
然而,反射器往往难以正确将失败的原因归结为即时.
在代理任务中,执行由与外部环境相互作用的牵引力调解,成功往往由LLM-as-a-judge(郑等人,2023年)评估.
因此,推出失败可能揭示出真正的迅速弱点,但也可能是外部因素造成的,例如缺乏必要的工具、使用限制,甚至执行或评价环境中的噪音。
在现实世界中,这个问题进一步加剧,因为任务本身可能含糊不清或不可行,给反射器带来更多的噪音信号。
然而,在修订该提示时,反射器可能将这些可能吵闹的观察视为有效的学习信号,以便迅速优化(Kirichenko等人,2025年),导致它错误地将相关故障分解为引发缺陷,从而产生不必要的或有害的更新。

blocks.en:
As an example, consider an agent asked to purchase an item from a shopping website.
If the agent fails because it overlooks a required option before adding the item to the cart, the Reflector can usefully revise the prompt to encourage checking required fields before proceeding.
In contrast, if the same task fails because it runs in a broken environment where the purchase button in the webpage is temporarily malfunctioning, treating this failure as evidence about the prompt may lead the Reflector to introduce unnecessary or even harmful changes.
For example, it may conclude that
the agent needs to seek alternative ways to complete the purchase, while the button can become functional for future tasks.
blocks.zh:
例如,考虑一名代理人要求从购物网站上购买物品。
如果代理人在将项目添加到推车之前忽略了必要的选项而失败,反射器可以有益地修改提示,以鼓励在进行前检查所需的字段。
相比之下,如果同一任务由于在网页中购买按钮暂时发生故障的破损环境中运行而失败,将这一失败作为及时性的证据,可能导致反射器引入不必要的甚至有害的改变.
例如,它可能得出以下结论:
代理需要寻找完成购买的替代方式,而按钮则可以用于未来的任务。

blocks.en:
To mitigate such issues, recent work ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) uses a held-out validation set in order to guard against these changes.
If the prompt does poorly on the validation set after mutation, the change can be rejected.
GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) goes a step further and evaluates the mutated prompt on the minibatch again to make sure that the model performance does not degrade after such a mutation.
However, such validation-based gating mechanisms alone may not be sufficient to prevent noisy signals, for two reasons.
First, bad mutations may be accepted and good ones rejected, e.g., because the gating decision relies on aggregated evaluation scores, which can be noisy due to stochasticity in execution or evaluation.
Second, such validation-based gating acts only after a mutation has been generated, and therefore cannot fundamentally improve the quality of the reflection or mutation itself.
This motivates us to maintain and provide additional contextual information in order to improve the capabilities of the Reflector.
blocks.zh:
为了减轻这些问题,最近的工作(Agrawal等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年)采用了搁置的验证,以防止这些变化。
如果在突变后的验证装置上,提示效果不佳,可以拒绝更改.
GEPA(Agrawal等人,2026年)更进一步,再次评价小批量上突变的提示,以确保模型性能不会在这样的突变后降解.
然而,由于两个原因,仅凭这种基于验证的标注机制可能不足以防止噪音信号。
首先,坏的变异可能被接受,好的变异可能被拒绝,例如,因为吉卜赛决定依赖于汇总评价分数,由于执行或评价时的花样偏差,这种分数可能很吵.
第二,这种基于验证的齿轮行为只有在发生突变后才发生,因此不能从根本上提高反射或突变本身的质量.
这促使我们保持并提供更多的背景资料,以提高反思者的能力。

blocks.en:
Based on these insights, we present GEPA-Curator, an agentic data Curator which runs as a harness on top of existing prompt optimizers.
GEPA-Curator has two roles.
The first is task curation , where instead of randomly selecting tasks for the minibatch, the agent will curate a minibatch which is likely to provide clean signal and discard tasks which seem to be noisy or faulty.
The second is a prior success retrieval , where the Curator can selectively retrieve past successful trajectories for a task and provide them as context to the prompt optimizer to improve the quality of the mutation.
Providing the Reflector agent with successful exemplars is essential to give the model the proper context to see why the prompt is failing now, and when it succeeded in the past.
blocks.zh:
基于这些见解,我们介绍了GEPA-Curator,一个代理数据Curator,它作为在现有的快速优化器上运行的绳索。
GEPA-Curator有两个角色.
第一是任务管理, 代理商不会随机选择小批量的任务, 而是会处理一个小批量,
第二种是事先成功检索,Curator可以有选择地检索过去成功的工作轨迹,并将其作为快速优化器的背景,以提高突变的质量。
向反射剂提供成功的范例,对于给模型适当的上下文以了解为什么即时电源现在和过去成功时都失败是至关重要的。

blocks.en: Overall, our contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们的捐款如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce GEPA-Curator, an agentic harness for prompt optimization that improves mutation quality through adaptive task curation (Section 3.1 ) and selective retrieval (Section 3.2 ) of prior successful trajectories. • We evaluate GEPA-Curator on four WebArena websites ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) , ALFWorld, AppWorld, and τ \tau -bench. GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of the evaluated baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) and 21.2% over ACE ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These results suggest that the benefits of curation extend across optimizer models.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们引入了GEPA-Curator,这是一个迅速优化的代理工具,通过适应性任务处理(第3.1节)和选择性检索(第3.2节)来提高突变的质量。 我们评价GEPA-Curator在四个WebArena网站(周等人,2024年),ALFWorld,AppWorld,以及\tau-bench。 GEPA-Curator匹配或超过被评价基线的平均性能,比GEPA增益高达20.7%(Agrawal等人,2026年),比ACE增益21.2%(Zhang等人,2026年)。 这些结果表明,管理的好处遍及优化模式。

GEPA-Curator matches or exceeds the mean performance of the evaluated baselines, with gains of up to 20.7% over GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) and 21.2% over ACE ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . These results suggest that the benefits of curation extend across optimizer models.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
As LLMs become ubiquitous, LLM-powered agents have been equipped with tools and harnesses in order to interact and execute in external environments.
React ( Yao et al., 2023 ) interwove reasoning with tool execution to improve performance.
Later work ( Patil et al., 2024 ; Erdogan et al., 2024 ; Schick et al., 2023 ; Shen et al., 2023 ; Xu et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ) used tool calling, where the model generates a structured output which is parsed and used to execute functions to affect the environment.
This has led to LLM agents being used to control and interact with different environments; and
this has led to a variety of different benchmarks ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ; Shridhar et al., 2021 ; Yao et al., 2024 ; Patil et al., 2024 ; Patil et al., 2025 ) to evaluate LLMs at tool calling.
blocks.zh:
随着LLMs变得无处不在,LLM动力的代理机构已经配备了工具和手段,以便在外部环境中进行互动和执行.
React (Yao et al., 2023) 推理与工具执行交互,以提高性能.
后来的作品(Patil等人,2024年;Erdogan等人,2024年;Schick等人,2023年;Shen等人,2023年;Xu等人,2023年;Kim等人,2024年)使用工具调用,模型生成一个结构化的输出,被解析出来,用来执行影响环境的功能.
这导致LLM剂被用于控制和与不同环境互动;以及
这导致了各种不同的基准(Trivedi等人,2024年;Shridhar等人,2021年;Yao等人,2024年;Patil等人,2024年;Patil等人,2025年),在工具调用时评价LLMs。

blocks.en:
One example is using LLMs as webagents in order to explore and act in web environments ( Qi et al., 2025 ; Erdogan et al., 2025 ; Gür et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) .
This has led to the development of various browser and computer use benchmarks and environments in this area ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Gandhi and Neubig, 2026 ; He et al., 2024 ; Xue et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2026 ; Rawles et al., 2023 ) .
Webarena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) was one of the first web environments and benchmarks to cover realistic websites such as GitLab, Reddit, Shopping portals, etc.
blocks.zh:
一个例子是使用LLMs作为网络代理,以便在网络环境中探索和采取行动(Qi等人,2025年;Erdogan等人,2025年;Gür等人,2023年;Kim等人,2023年;Yang等人,2025年)。
这导致了该领域各种浏览器和计算机使用基准和环境的发展(周等人,2024年;甘地和诺伊比格,2026年;他等人,2024年;薛等人,2025年;谢等人,2024年;袁等人,2026年;罗尔斯等人,2023年).
Webarena(周.等人,2024年)是最早覆盖GitLab,Reddit,购物门户等现实主义网站的网络环境和基准之一.

blocks.en:
Reflective optimizers use natural language feedback in place of numerical gradients to revise textual components of an AI system ( Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ; Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2023b ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Pryzant et al., 2023 ; Opsahl-Ong et al., 2024 ) .
In particular, GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) applies reflection to system-level trajectories, using evaluator feedback to diagnose failures and propose prompt mutations within an evolutionary search.
ACE ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) introduced a framework for agentic context adaptation to create structured playbooks to organize and accumulate strategies at runtime.
SkillOpt ( Yang et al., 2026 ) similarly treats an agent’s skill document as trainable external state; a separate optimizer analyzes scored rollouts and proposes bounded add, delete, or replace edits.
Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ) extended this idea further by having an outer optimization loop on the harness code which runs the agent instead of just the prompt.
These methods demonstrate that execution traces can provide substantially richer optimization signals than scalar rewards alone.
GEPA-Curator addresses a complementary question: which agentic trajectories provide a valid signal for reflection, and what historical evidence should accompany them?
blocks.zh:
反思优化者使用自然语言反馈来代替数值梯度来修改AI系统的文字成分(Yukekgonul等人,2024年;Agrawal等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年;Zhang等人,2026年;Zhou等人,2023年b;Yang等人,2024年;Pryzant等人,2023年;Opsahl-Ong等人,2024年).
特别是GEPA(Agrawal等人,2026年)将反射应用于系统层面的轨迹,利用评价反馈来诊断故障,并在进化搜索中提出迅速突变.
ACE(Zhang等人,2026年)引入了代理环境适应框架,以创建结构化的游戏本,在运行时组织和积累策略.
SkillOpt(Yang等人,2026年)同样将代理人的技能文件视为可训练的外部状态;一个单独的优化器分析得分的推出,并提议加、删除或替换编辑。
Meta-Harness(Lee et al., 2026年)进一步扩展了这个想法,在运行代理而不是仅仅是即时的带码上有一个外部优化循环.
这些方法表明,执行痕迹可以提供比光是scalar奖励更丰富的优化信号.
GEPA-Curator谈到一个补充性问题:哪些代理轨迹为反射提供了有效的信号,以及应该随附哪些历史证据?

blocks.en:
Curriculum Learning ( Bengio et al., 2009 ; Fan et al., 2018 ) studies how the selection and ordering of training data can improve optimization and model training.
Recent work ( Zhou et al., 2023a ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2024 ; Diao et al., 2024 ) has looked into how this can affect LLM training and alignment.
LIMA ( Zhou et al., 2023a ) established how having poorer quality data can negatively affect LLM alignment, and showed that a small amount of high-quality data can be as effective as a large scale training set.
blocks.zh:
课程学习(Bengio等人,2009年;Fan等人,2018年)研究如何选择和订购培训数据可以改善优化和模式培训.
最近的工作(周等人,2023a); Chen等人,2024年;Wang等人,2024年;Lee等人,2024年;Diao等人,2024年)研究了这如何影响LLM培训和校对.
LIMA(周某1等人,2023a)确定了质量数据较差会如何对LLM校正产生不利影响,并表明少量的高质量数据可以和大规模训练集一样有效.

blocks.en: 3 GEPA-Curator Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 GEPA-计算方法

blocks.en:
In this section, we describe how GEPA-Curator integrates with existing prompt optimizers.
To do so, we first formulate a prompt optimizer by its input-output interface.
At each step, a prompt optimizer receives a prompt, a minibatch of tasks, and optionally some input metadata. It executes the tasks using an actor agent conditioned on the prompt and returns an updated prompt, task-level agent trajectories, and evaluation results (See Figure 1 ).
Ordinary prompt optimizers randomly permute and iterate through the tasks in the training dataset at each step.
We identify a few points in existing prompt optimizers where noisy optimization signals can arise.
When selecting tasks to execute, some tasks may yield noisy or unhelpful trajectories.
Furthermore, when reflecting on execution results, some failures may be difficult to attribute correctly from the failed trajectory alone.
In Section 5.1 , we present motivating experiments showing how such noisy signals can propagate through the optimization process and ultimately degrade training.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们描述了GEPA-Curator如何与现有的即时优化器融合.
为此,我们首先通过其输入-输出接口制定快速优化器。
在每个步骤上,一个即时优化器都会收到一个即时,小批次的任务,以及一些可选的输入元数据. 它使用以即时为条件的行为者代理执行任务,并返回更新的即时,任务级代理轨迹,以及评价结果(见图1)。
普通的快速优化器随机地穿透每个步骤的训练数据集中的任务.
我们在现有的快速优化器中找出了几个点,在这些点上可以产生噪音优化信号。
在选择要执行的任务时,一些任务可能会产生吵闹或无益的轨迹.
此外,在考虑执行结果时,有些失败可能难以从失败的轨迹中正确归因。
在第5.1节中,我们提出一些激励性实验,说明这种噪音信号如何通过优化过程传播并最终降低培训。

blocks.en:
GEPA-Curator runs as a harness on top of the optimizer,
maintaining a per-task history, including agent trajectories and evaluation outcomes from previous optimization steps.
The Curator uses this history to address these sources of noise through two corresponding roles:
(i) task curation (Section 3.1 ), which selects tasks likely to provide useful signal for prompt optimization to construct the next minibatch;
and
(ii) prior success retrieval (Section 3.2 ), which retrieves relevant past successful trajectories for tasks in the current minibatch to provide the Reflector with concrete contextual references for failure diagnosis.
Note that these trajectories are provided to the prompt optimizer only as additional input metadata, leaving the optimizer itself unchanged.
The full workflow is depicted in Figure 1 .
We have found that both of these methods are critical for performance (Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh:
GEPA-Curator在优化器上作为绳索运行,
保持每个任务的历史,包括代理轨迹和以往优化步骤的评价结果。
Curator利用这个历史通过两个相应的角色来解决这些噪音源:
(一) 任务管理(第3.1节),选择可能为迅速优化提供有用信号的任务,以构建下一个小批量;
和
(二) 事先成功检索(第3.2节),为当前小批次中的任务检索过去成功的相关轨迹,为反射器提供故障诊断的具体背景参考。
注意这些轨迹仅作为附加输入元数据提供给快速优化器,使优化器本身保持不变.
图1列出了整个工作流程。
我们发现这两种方法对业绩至关重要(第4.3节)。

blocks.en:
Figure 1: GEPA-Curator system diagram.
The prompt optimizer takes in a minibatch of tasks at each iteration and invokes the actor agent to execute them and performs reflective prompt optimization based on the resulting trajectories.
The Curator augments the prompt optimizer by acting as an outer-loop process which traverses through the training dataset and constructs each minibatch to pass into the prompt optimizer.
The Curator reads past execution trajectories for each task sampled from the training dataset and decides to run the task if doing so is likely to provide useful optimization signal (Section 3.1 ).
The Curator can also pass prior successful trajectories for failed tasks as context to the prompt optimizer as a trusted reference example (Section 3.2 ).
Once the curated training batch of selected tasks and successful context is constructed, it is passed to the prompt optimizer for execution and optimization.
The resulting trajectories and evaluation outcomes are then written back to the task history for use in subsequent curation rounds.
blocks.zh:
图1:GEPA-Curator系统图。
即时优化器在每个迭代都承担小批任务,并援引演员代理执行,并根据由此产生的轨迹进行反射即时优化.
Curator通过一个通过培训数据集穿梭的外向跳动过程来增强即时优化器,并构建每个小批次通过即时优化器.
Curator读取了从培训数据集中取样的每项任务的过去执行轨迹,如果这样做有可能提供有用的优化信号,则决定执行这项任务(第3.1节)。
Curator还可以通过先前成功的任务轨迹,作为快捷优化器的上下文,作为可信赖的参考实例(第3.2节).
一旦完成了所选任务和成功背景的整理培训批次,就交给迅速优化者执行和优化。
由此产生的轨迹和评价结果随后被写回任务历史,用于以后的勘测回合.

blocks.en: 3.1 Task Curation
blocks.zh: 3.1 任务说明

blocks.en:
The Curator examines the training tasks and selects which tasks to run at each optimization step.
Underexplored tasks are initially prioritized to build sufficient per-task history.
As this history accumulates, the Curator may skip a task when there is strong evidence that further rollouts are unlikely to yield useful reflection signal for prompt optimization.
Such cases include repeated stable success, repeated failures caused by factors outside the prompt (e.g., harness or environment limitations), and inconsistent evaluations of similar outcomes, which can be judged based on the accumulated per-task history.
blocks.zh:
库拉托审查培训任务,并选择每个优化步骤中要执行的任务。
探索不足的任务最初被优先安排,以建立足够的每个任务的历史.
随着这一历史的积累,当有确凿证据表明进一步展开不太可能产生有用的反射信号以迅速优化时,库拉托尔可能会跳过一项任务.
此类案例包括反复取得稳定的成功,由迅速因素以外的因素(例如,利用或环境限制)造成的反复失败,以及对类似结果的不一致评价,这些评价可以根据每个任务累积的历史来判断。

blocks.en:
Importantly, skipping is a temporary decision rather than a permanent decision, and thus skipped tasks are reconsidered by the Curator at each training epoch.
This is necessary because tasks that were previously solved may regress as the prompt is updated for other tasks, e.g., through prompt compression or the addition of potentially conflicting rules.
Conversely, tasks that were initially too difficult, and therefore skipped after repeated failures, may become solvable as the prompt improves and can be reintroduced into training.
blocks.zh:
重要的是,跳过是一个临时决定,而不是一个永久性决定,因此,在每次培训时都由管理员重新考虑跳过的任务。
这样做是必要的,因为以前解决的任务可能会随着其他任务的提示更新而退步,例如通过迅速压缩或增加可能相互冲突的规则.
相反,最初过于困难的任务,在屡屡失败后被忽略,随着迅速的改进,这些任务可能无法完成,可以重新培训。

blocks.en: 3.2 Prior Success Retrieval
blocks.zh: 3.2 以往成功检索

blocks.en:
Normally, prompt optimizers reflect on failure examples in the current minibatch and mutate the prompt based only on the failed trajectories and their evaluations.
Therefore, pairing a current failed execution with prior successful executions of the same task allows the Reflector to perform contrastive learning of the failed behavior against a known and trusted reference.
This provides the Reflector with a concrete basis for correcting the behavior, rather than forcing it to diagnose the failure by guessing.
blocks.zh:
通常情况下,即时优化器只根据失败的轨迹及其评价来反思当前小批量中的失败实例,并变换即时.
因此,将当前失败的处决与先前成功执行同一任务进行配对,可以使反射器对照已知和可信赖的引用对失败的行为进行对比学习.
这为反射器提供了纠正行为的具体基础,而不是迫使它通过猜测来诊断失败.

blocks.en:
The Curator is instructed to reason over the task history to select one successful trajectory that provides the most reliable reference for the current task.
In particular, it favors successes supported by consistent evaluation evidence and avoids using outcomes whose apparent success is ambiguous or inconsistent with other observations in the history.
When no appropriate success is available, the Curator abstains and does not provide this metadata to the Reflector.
This approach prevents noisy success trajectories from providing misleading positive examples, in the same way that removing noisy failure trajectories prevents misleading optimization signals.
The prompt for task curation and prior success retrieval is provided at Appendix B.2 .
Note that because task curation and prior-success retrieval are performed jointly in a single Curator call, the latter requires no additional LLM invocation.
blocks.zh:
库拉托被指示对任务历史进行推理,选择一个为当前任务提供最可靠参考的成功轨迹.
特别是,它赞成在一致的评价证据支持下取得成功,并避免使用明显成功或与历史上其他观察不一致的结果。
如果没有适当的成功,Curator就弃权,不向反射器提供这一元数据。
这种方法防止吵闹的成功轨迹提供误导性的正面例子,同样消除吵闹的失败轨迹也防止误导性的优化信号.
任务处理和事先成功检索的及时性载于附录B.2。
请注意,由于任务校准和前期成功检索都是在一个Curator呼叫中联合进行的,后者不需要额外的LLM引用.

blocks.en:
In summary, these two components of GEPA-Curator (task curation and prior success retrieval) work in unison to ensure that the prompt optimizer gets cleaner and curated data to train on.
By curating the tasks in each minibatch, we maximize the amount of signal provided at each step of the optimization loop through removing noisy or redundant tasks.
By providing reliable past successful trajectories to the Reflector, we enable the Reflector to create better mutations with grounded understanding instead of guessing the fix.
blocks.zh:
简而言之,GEPA-Curator的这两个组成部分(任务校准和前期成功检索)一致工作,以确保迅速优化者得到更清洁和整理的数据来训练。
通过管理每个小批量中的任务,我们通过去除吵闹或冗余的任务,最大限度地增加在优化循环的每个步骤上提供的信号量.
通过向反射器提供可靠的过去成功的轨迹,我们使得反射器能够用有根据的理解创造更好的突变,而不是猜测定律.

blocks.en: 4 Empirical Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 经验评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
We compare GEPA-Curator against GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) and ACE ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
GEPA-Curator builds on a simplified, greedy variant of GEPA that removes Pareto-based candidate selection.
Rather than evolving a candidate pool and sampling from the Pareto frontier on validation set, GEPA-Curator maintains a single lineage in which each mutation becomes the next checkpoint.
We evaluate the prompt every 16 iterations unless specified on a held-out validation set and select the final model based on the best validation score at the end.
Because our ablation showed little difference between GEPA with and without Pareto selection, we adopt this greedy variant for simplicity.
blocks.zh:
我们比较GEPA-Curator与GEPA(Agrawal等人,2026年)和ACE(张等人,2026年).
GEPA-Curator基于GEPA的一个简化的,贪婪的变体,取消了基于Pareto的候选人选择.
GEPA-Curator没有在验证组上从Pareto边界发展出一个候选库和取样,而是维持一个单一的序列,其中每个突变成为下一个检查站。
我们每16次重复评估一次,除非在被搁置的验证装置上具体说明,并根据最后的最佳验证分数选择最后的模型。
因为我们的淡化显示 GEPA 与没有Pareto 的选择没有什么区别, 我们采用了这个贪婪的变体 简单。

blocks.en:
The prompt-optimization experiments use gpt-oss-120b ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) as the actor agent.
We evaluate two optimizer models, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview ( DeepMind, 2026 ) and Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026 ) , using the selected model for all optimizer-side agents, including the Reflector and Curator, within each run. The minibatch size is 16.
The actor’s maximum context length is set to gpt-oss-120B’s native maximum context length (131072) so we constrain the optimized prompt to fit within this limit.
All seed prompts used for optimization are manually written.
The evaluation numbers are averaged over 5 repeated runs.

即时优化实验使用gpt-oss-120b(Agarwal等人,2025年)作为演员代理.
我们评价了双子座3.1 Pro预览(DeepMind,2026年)和克劳德·奥普斯5(Anthropic,2026年)两个优化型号,在每个运行范围内对所有优化型号,包括反射器和Curator,使用所选择的型号. 小批量尺寸为16.
演员的最大上下文长度被设定为gpt-oss-120B的本土最大上下文长度(131072),因此我们限制优化的提示以适应这个限度.
用于优化的所有种子提示都是手动写入的.
评价数字平均为5次重复。

blocks.en:
For evaluation of optimization on noisy data, we experimented with tasks from GoBrowse ( Gandhi and Neubig, 2026 ) : GitLab (720 tasks), Shopping (585 tasks), Shopping Admin (750 tasks), and Reddit (585 tasks) in the WebArena environment ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) .
Each website is independently split 3 : 1 : 1 3{:}1{:}1 into train, validation, and held-out test sets. All methods use the same seed prompt, evaluator, action limits, and environment configuration.
Each website/method uses 5,000 rollouts, which has been chosen to ensure that all the methods can reach their saturated success rate.
blocks.zh:
为了评价噪音数据的优化,我们尝试了来自GoBrowse(Gandhi和Neubig,2026年)的任务:GitLab(720项任务),购物(585项任务),购物管理(750项任务),以及WebArena环境中的Reddit(585项任务) (周等人,2024年).
每个网站分别独立拆分 3 :1 :1 3{:}1{:}1 } 进入列车,验证,和停运测试集. 所有方法都使用相同的种子即时,评估,动作限制,以及环境配置.
每个网站/方法都使用5,000个推出,这是为了确保所有方法都能达到饱和的成功率。

blocks.en:
We additionally evaluated on more agentic datasets, namely ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) , AppWorld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) , and τ \tau -bench ( Yao et al., 2024 ) .
For ALFWorld, we sample 150 training tasks and 50 validation tasks from official train and valid_seen splits to train with 2000 rollouts, and evaluate on all 134 valid_unseen tasks.
For AppWorld, we use the official dataset splits with 1500 rollouts in training, and report score based on Task Goal Completion. For τ \tau -bench, we remove user interaction as done in ( Sayana et al., 2026 ) by flattening all 115 interactive scenarios from the retail test set into single requests, and partition them into 48 training tasks, 32 validation, and 35 held-out test tasks with 800 rollouts. The rollout budget per benchmark was chosen to ensure that all methods can reach their saturated success rate. τ \tau -bench specifically validates every 4 iterations due to its small training data.

我们进一步评估了更多的代理人数据集,即ALFWorld(Shridhar等人,2021年),AppWorld(Trivedi等人,2024年)和\tau-bench(姚等人,2024年)。
对于ALFWorld,我们从正式列车中抽取了150个训练任务和50个验证任务,并用2000年的推出来进行有效_见分拆,评价所有134个有效_见分解的任务.
对AppWorld来说,我们使用官方数据集在培训中进行1500次推广,并根据任务目标完成情况报告分数。 对\tau-bench来说,我们取消了用户互动,如(Sayana等人,2026年)所做的那样,将零售测试设定的所有115个互动情景平整成单一请求,并分为48个培训任务、32个验证任务和35个搁置测试任务,并有800个推出。 选择每个基准的推出预算是为了确保所有方法都达到饱和的成功率。 \tau - bench 因其培训数据小而专门验证每四个迭代。

This suggests that curation materially increases how much performance can be improved from the same initial prompt.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Motivating Experiments
blocks.zh: 5.1 激励实验

blocks.en: To understand how noisy learning signals from flaky or impossible tasks can negatively impact agent learning by contaminating the prompt, we categorize GoBrowse GitLab tasks into four groups: Easy , Optimizable , Impossible , and Flaky . Easy tasks achieve constant success before optimization. Optimizable tasks initially perform suboptimally but can be improved through prompt optimization. Flaky tasks and Impossible tasks are the ones that cannot be improved, with Impossible tasks showing constant failure and Flaky tasks having mixed success due to ambiguous task intent or judge flakiness.
blocks.zh: 为了了解来自片面或不可能的任务的噪音学习信号如何通过污染提示对代理人学习产生不利影响,我们把GoBrowse GitLab的任务分为四组: 简单,乐观,不可能,和弗莱基。 简单的任务在优化前会不断取得成功. 可优化的任务最初表现不理想,但可以通过即时优化加以改进. 难以完成的任务和不可能完成的任务是无法改进的任务,不可能完成的任务经常失败,而且由于任务意图模糊或判断故障,难以完成的任务有好有坏。

blocks.en:
We study how GEPA learns from Optimizable tasks
under three different compositional scenarios: Optimizable + Easy , Optimizable + Impossible , and Optimizable + Flaky . Figure 2 shows the resulting learning curves. When Optimizable tasks are combined with Easy tasks, GEPA achieves near-perfect accuracy. In contrast, the accuracy only peaks at 12/16 when Optimizable tasks are mixed with Impossible or Flaky tasks. These results suggest that learning signals from Impossible and Flaky tasks can contaminate the prompt and hinder optimization.
More details on how these tasks are classified and a qualitative analysis of the failure cases can be found in Appendices A.1 and A.2 .

blocks.en: 5.3 Meta-Harness-Curator
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 Meta- Harness- 计算器

blocks.en:
Recently, Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026 ) introduced an optimization loop which acts on the harness code of agents in a similar manner to how GEPA optimizes prompts.
In this section, we extend the curation approach of GEPA-Curator to Meta-Harness, which we call Meta-Harness-Curator, to explore whether curation offers additional benefits when the optimizer itself has greater autonomy.
blocks.zh:
最近,梅塔哈内斯 (Lee et al., 2026)引入了优化循环,它以类似GEPA优化提示的方式作用于代理的操纵码.
在本节中,我们将GEPA-Curator的校准方法扩展至Meta-Harness,我们称之为Meta-Harness-Curator,以探索当优化者自身拥有更大的自主性时,校准是否带来额外好处.

blocks.en: Although the coding agent used in the default Meta-Harness can inspect the full execution history, it must decide which failures to investigate while also reasoning about and modifying the harness. Curation may help by directing this investigation toward a focused set of tasks and relevant prior successes, providing concrete evidence to guide code changes. We hypothesize that this division of work becomes more useful as the pool of training tasks and execution histories grows.
blocks.zh: 虽然默认的Meta-Harness中使用的编码代理可以检查完整的执行历史,但它必须决定哪些未能调查,同时还要对套装进行推理和修改. 通过指导这项调查,确定一套重点任务和以往的相关成功,提供具体证据,指导代码的修改,可能有助于澄清。 我们假设,随着培训任务和执行历史的增加,这种分工将变得更加有用。

blocks.en: We augment Meta-Harness with a Curator that inspects candidate code, training histories, and aggregate development scores to select a parent harness and a subset of training tasks, together with a rationale. The parent is freshly executed on these tasks, and the optimizer revises it using the resulting feedback and the Curator’s rationale. Each child is evaluated on the same tasks as its parent and on the full development set, regardless of whether its training score improves. Both agents can inspect prior training histories, including earlier modifications and their outcomes. The Curator may also select historical successful executions of the chosen tasks as references, which are passed to the optimizer only when the corresponding fresh parent executions fail. These references link to the original trajectories and the harnesses that produced them. Training and development executions count toward the search budget, and the candidate with the highest development score is selected for final test evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个Curator来增加Meta-Harness, 检查候选代码、训练历史和综合发展分数, 母体在这些任务上被新执行,优化者利用由此产生的反馈和Curator的理由来修改. 每个儿童都接受与其父母相同的任务和全套发展评价,无论培训成绩是否提高。 两名人员都可以检查以前的培训历史,包括较早的修改及其结果。 库拉托尔还可以选择历史上成功执行所选任务作为参考,只有在相应的新父母处决失败时,才转交给优化者. 这些参考文献链接到原始的轨迹和产生它们的绳索. 培训和发展处决数计入搜索预算,发展得分最高的候选人被选入最终测试评价.

blocks.en: We evaluate on the Math-RAG and online text classification settings studied by Meta-Harness, with separate development sets for candidate selection. Math-RAG uses 150 training, 100 development, and 200 test tasks, with a budget of 15,000 training and development solver calls. The test set comprises IMO-AnswerBench and IMO-ProofBench ( Luong et al., 2025 ) , and the December 2025 and January 2026 releases of ArXivMath ( Dekoninck et al., 2026 ) . Text classification covers USPTO-50k (USPTO) ( Schneider et al., 2016 ) , Symptom2Disease (S2D) ( Gretel AI, 2023 ) , and LawBench (Law) ( Fei et al., 2024 ) , using 130 training, 92 development, and 320 test tasks in total and a budget of 10,000 training and development actor calls. The labeled examples used to construct classification memories are separate from these optimization tasks; memory construction is excluded from the budget. Both methods share the same splits and initial harnesses. We use gpt-oss-20B as the Math-RAG solver and judge, gpt-oss-120B as the classification actor, and Codex with GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) for the optimizer and Curator. Actors and coding agents use medium reasoning effort, while the math judge uses high reasoning effort. We run one optimization experiment per method and setting, then evaluate each development-selected harness with three samples per test task.

blocks.en: 5.4 Efficiency optimization and Cost Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 效率优化和成本分析

blocks.en: While GEPA-Curator is designed with active agent involvement to demonstrate the potential of agent-designed curriculum as a promising direction for self-improvement, we also develope a more efficient variant and conduct a cost analysis to evaluate its practicality for cost-efficient deployment.
blocks.zh: 虽然GEPA-Curator的设计有积极的代理参与,以证明由代理设计的课程作为自我改进的有希望的方向的潜力,但我们还开发了一个更有效的变体,并进行成本分析,以评估其成本效益部署的实用性。

blocks.en:
We introduce three modifications to improve the cost efficiency of GEPA-Curator while preserving its effectiveness:
(1) Skip interval decision. Instead of making a skip decision at every epoch, the Curator specifies the number of epochs to skip, eliminating repeated Curator calls during the skip interval.
(2) Compact task history. Each Curator call receives full trajectories from a configurable number of recent executions, while older executions are represented by compact summaries containing their epoch numbers, outcomes, and previous Curator assessments. This reduces the growth of the Curator’s input context as optimization progresses.
(3) Successful trajectory retention. Since complete task history is no longer available, we retain an optional full successful trajectory, which is always provided to the Reflector upon each failure when available. During task curation, the Curator can replace this reference with a better successful trajectory from recent executions.
blocks.zh:
我们进行了三项修改,以提高GEPA-Curator的成本效率,同时保持其有效性:
(1) 跳过间隔决定。 Curator没有在每个时段作出跳过决定,而是指定要跳过的时间段数,在跳过间隔期间取消了重复的Curator呼叫.
(2)契约任务历史. 每一次Curator呼叫都收到大量最新处决的完整轨迹,而较老的处决则通过简洁的概要来表示,其中包含其时代数字、结果和以前的Curator评估。 这随着优化的进展而减少了Curator输入语境的增长.
(3) 成功保留轨迹。 由于没有完整的任务历史,我们保留了可选的完全成功轨迹,每次失败时总是提供给反射器。 在任务调查期间,审判官可以以最近处决的更好成功轨迹取代这一提法。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In conclusion, we introduce GEPA-Curator, a framework which augments prompt optimization to select which agentic tasks should shape prompt optimization.
A Curator is used to agentically select and filter out tasks based on whether they can provide noisy or reliable training signals.
Furthermore, the Curator can retrieve and provide prior successful trajectories for failed tasks and gives them to the prompt optimizer to act as an anchoring context for reflections.
We show that this technique achieves consistent performance improvements over GEPA and ACE by up to 21.2% on Webarena, ALFWorld, AppWorld, and τ \tau -bench.
We further extend our method to Meta-Harness and show that this agentic curation idea can even improve harness code as well.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们引入了GEPA-Curator(GEPA-Curator),这个框架可以加强即时优化,以选择哪些代理任务应该塑造即时优化.
一个Curator用于根据任务能否提供吵闹或可靠的训练信号进行代理选择和过滤.
此外,Curator还可以为失败的任务检索和提供之前成功的轨迹,并给予这些轨迹迅速的优化器,作为反射的锚定背景.
我们显示这一技术比GEPA和ACE在Webarena、ALFWorld、AppWorld和\tau - bench上取得了21.2%的一致性能改进。
我们进一步将方法推广到Meta-Harness, 并表明这种代理化的规范思想甚至可以改进绳索密码。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This work presents a generic method for improving prompts for LLM agents, rather than a system designed for a specific domain.
Potential positive impacts include making agentic systems more reliable, adaptable, and accessible to researchers and practitioners.
Potential negative impacts are indirect: stronger LLM agents could be misused in harmful ways, or could cause harm if deployed in high-risk environments without proper human supervision.
We emphasize that optimized agents should be evaluated in the intended environment and used with appropriate human oversight, monitoring, and controls.

潜在的消极影响是间接的:较强的LLM剂可能会被滥用到有害的方面,或者如果在没有适当的人类监督的情况下部署在高风险环境中可能造成伤害。
我们强调,应在预定的环境下对优化剂进行评估,并在使用时进行适当的人类监督、监测和控制。

blocks.en: Appendix A Details about Motivating Experiments

blocks.en: A.1 Selection of Dataset Composition
blocks.zh: A.1 数据集组成的选择

blocks.en: Before constructing the experimental datasets for the motivating examples, we use logs from several preliminary GitLab experiments to identify tasks corresponding to different labels. For Easy tasks, we select tasks that already achieve consistently high success rates with the seed prompt. For Optimizable tasks, we first identify tasks that achieve consistent success with the optimized prompt from at least one preliminary GEPA run, and then select, from this subset, those with the lowest success rates under the seed prompt. For Impossible tasks, we select tasks with the lowest success rates across all rollouts. For Flaky tasks, we first identify tasks that achieve roughly 50% success with both the seed prompt and the optimized prompts returned by the preliminary GEPA runs. We then manually inspect these tasks and prioritize cases where the LLM-as-a-judge produces inconsistent success and failure judgments despite similar or identical end states, particularly when even the best attainable end state does not yield consistently successful judgments.
blocks.zh: 在为激励性实例构建实验数据集之前,我们使用几个初步的GitLab实验的日志来识别与不同标签相对应的任务. 对于容易完成的任务,我们选择在种子迅速的情况下已经达到一贯高成功率的任务。 对于 最佳任务,我们首先从至少一个初步的GEPA运行中找出能够取得一致成功的任务,然后从这个子集中选择种子提示下成功率最低的任务. 对于不可能完成的任务,我们选择在所有推广中成功率最低的任务。 对于 首先,我们确定哪些任务 能够取得大约50%的成功 种子快报和最佳快报 由初步的GEPA运行。 然后,我们手工检查这些任务,并优先处理LLM-as-a-法官在类似或相同结局的情况下作出不一致的成败判决的案件,特别是即使最佳的终局状态也不能取得一致的成功判决。

blocks.en: A.2 A Concrete Example of Negative Transfer
blocks.zh: A.2 消极转让的具体实例

blocks.en: We trace an accepted prompt mutation from iteration 7 of the Optimizable + Impossible condition. Two tasks from the Impossible partition had failed under the parent prompt. For “View the split_silence.py example for audio processing,” global search returned no useful result, and the evaluator suggested manually browsing projects and groups. For “Expand a subgroup in the hierarchy list to view nested subgroups,” the actor searched public groups containing no expandable subgroup, and the evaluator suggested checking the actor’s own groups instead. Both tasks are considered Impossible because their underspecified intents identify neither a target repository nor a group, leaving the actor to explore without direction, frequently exhausting its step budget before succeeding and making the tasks difficult to optimize through prompting. Reflection converted this feedback into a stronger exhaustive-search instruction: Exhaustive Exploration: Global code search is often limited or disabled. If a search yields no results, manually navigate through groups, projects, and repository file trees. Always check “Your groups”, “Your projects”, and your personal dashboard before defaulting to public “Explore” tabs, as task resources are usually associated with your account. Its exhaustive-search instruction caused a regression on the Optimizable task “Check the guide to WCAG documents and standards.” Immediately before the mutation, the actor recognized The A11Y Project on its starting page, opened the repository, used Find file to search for WCAG , and reached src/posts/wcag2-documents.md in five actions. With the mutated prompt, instead of opening the visible A11Y Project directly, the actor first filtered its personal projects, then traversed Explore, Topics, Help, global search, and group pages. After eventually returning to the A11Y Project, it inspected the README and Wiki and manually traversed the repository tree. It exhausted all 30 actions in the src directory without reaching the guide.

blocks.en: The exhaustive-search instruction caused the regression by replacing the short repository-level search path with broad exploration across site sections and the repository tree. Nevertheless, the aggregate minibatch score increased from 8 to 9, so the mutation was accepted as candidate 5. This example provides a concrete mechanism for the trend in Figure 2 : feedback from difficult tasks can elicit an overgeneralized search strategy whose aggregate gain masks a regression on a solvable task.
blocks.zh: 详尽无遗的搜索指令导致了回归,将短的存储器级搜索路径替换为跨站点段和存储器树的广泛探索. 尽管如此,总小批量分数还是从8分增加到9分,因此该突变被接受为候选人5. 这个例子为图2中的趋势提供了具体机制:从困难任务中得到的反馈可以引起过于笼统的搜索策略,其总收益掩盖了可完成的任务的倒退。

blocks.en: A.3 Implementation of Numerical Curriculum
blocks.zh: A.3 执行数字课程

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Numerical curriculum
blocks.zh: 算术 1 数字课程

blocks.en: The numerical curriculum modifies GEPA’s dataset sampling procedure to progressively remove tasks that repeatedly fail during optimization. The intuition is that persistently unsuccessful tasks may contribute unhelpful feedback and cause the optimized prompt to grow unnecessarily without yielding corresponding performance gains. To identify such tasks, we maintain a running score s t s_{t} for each task t t . Whenever a task fails, its score is incremented by one; when it succeeds, the score is decreased by k k , lower bounded at zero. This allows occasional failures to be tolerated while assigning larger scores to tasks that fail consistently over time. Once s t s_{t} exceeds a threshold b b , the task is removed from the sampling pool for subsequent optimization iterations.
blocks.zh: 数字课程修改了GEPA的数据集采样程序,以逐步取消在优化过程中一再失败的任务. 直觉是,持续不成功的任务可能会造成无益的反馈,并导致优化的迅速增长,而不产生相应的业绩收益。 为了确定这些任务,我们为每个任务保留一个运行中的分数。 当任务失败时,它的分数会递增一个;成功时,分数会减少k k ,以0为界降低. 这使得偶尔可以容忍失败,同时为长期持续失败的任务分配更大的分数。 一旦 s t s_{t} 超过一个阈值 b b , 任务会被从采样池中移除以进行后续的优化迭代.

blocks.en: Task-Selection Instructions You are a task curator allocating evaluation budget during text optimization. Judge this task independently: no other task is visible. Decide whether another rollout is currently useful for learning a better prompt or obtaining information about the task. Use these definitions: Mastered: Multiple stable, clean successes across separate rollouts. The agent must complete the task correctly, not merely benefit from evaluator luck, leaked state, or an accidentally correct final page. There must be no recent regression. One success is not sufficient evidence of mastery. Prompt-sensitive: Before/after evaluation pairs show that prompt changes can improve the behavior, including partial behavioral correction even when the binary score does not change. Run these tasks. Operationally impossible: The available tools or UI genuinely lack the required capability, supported by the action schema, trajectory-derived diagnostics, reference evaluation, or evaluator evidence. A single unsupported actor claim is insufficient; repeated independent attempts consistently identifying the same missing essential capability are meaningful evidence. No current optimization signal: The same failure mode persists across multiple materially relevant prompt mutations, with no behavioral progress or new diagnostic information. Do not infer this merely because several mutations failed when they did not address the observed failure. Flaky or uninformative: Materially similar behavior and ending states repeatedly receive inconsistent outcomes without a credible relationship to prompt changes. Do not infer flakiness from one disagreement. Evaluator-broken: There is explicit evidence of an incorrect label, stale or contradictory target, or an evaluator expectation inconsistent with the user request. A brittle, unusually strict, or difficult evaluator is not necessarily broken. Infrastructure failure: Timeout, reset, network errors, or local-state/file collisions caused by missing resets provide no evidence about prompt quality. Do not interpret them as agent failures. Uncertain: Run rather than skip. A rollout has information value: use it to test uncertain mastery, suspected flakiness, possible regressions, or ambiguous failure mechanisms. Run unseen or underexplored tasks and tasks with credible prompt-sensitive failures. Skip only when the history provides strong evidence that another rollout currently has little optimization or diagnostic value. A mutation_comparison records paired before/after evaluations even when the proposed mutation was rejected. Use an improved after result as evidence that the task may be prompt-sensitive, but when mutation_accepted is false, do not assume that behavior belongs to the current prompt or that the task is now mastered. A skip is revisited in a later epoch; it is not a permanent retirement. In the reason, cite the specific historical evidence supporting the decision.

blocks.en: GoBrowse Judge: System Prompt You are an expert in evaluating the performance of a web navigation agent. The agent is designed to help a human user navigate a website to complete a task. Given the user’s intent, the agent’s action history, the final state of the webpage, and the agent’s response to the user, your goal is to decide whether the agent’s execution is successful or not. There are three types of tasks: 1. Information seeking: The user wants to obtain certain information from the webpage, such as the information of a product, reviews, map info, comparison of map routes, etc. The bot’s response must contain the information the user wants, or explicitly state that the information is not available. Otherwise, e.g. the bot encounters an exception and respond with the error content, the task is considered a failure. Besides, be careful about the sufficiency of the agent’s actions. For example, when asked to list the top-searched items in a shop, the agent should order the items by the number of searches, and then return the top items. If the ordering action is missing, the task is likely to fail. 2. Site navigation: The user wants to navigate to a specific page. Carefully examine the bot’s action history and the final state of the webpage to determine whether the bot successfully completes the task. No need to consider the bot’s response. 3. Content modification: The user wants to modify the content of a webpage or configuration. Carefully examine the bot’s action history and the final state of the webpage to determine whether the bot successfully completes the task. No need to consider the bot’s response. *IMPORTANT* Format your response into two lines as shown below: Thoughts: <your thoughts and reasoning process> Status: “success” or “failure”

blocks.en: Appendix C Details of Curator Decisions
blocks.zh: 附录C 监管者决定的细节

blocks.en: C.1 Analysis of Task Selection
blocks.zh: C.1 任务选择分析

blocks.en: We analyze the task-selection decisions made by the Curator across the four GoBrowse runs with Gemini 3.1 pro as optimizer. Table 9 reports tasks that the Curator explicitly described as impossible or flaky (and thus were not selected for the corresponding training batch) at any point during optimization. The two diagnosis categories overlap for 8 tasks: 18 impossible and 65 flaky diagnoses cover 75 unique tasks in total.
blocks.zh: 我们分析Curator在GoBrowse的四场比赛中 做出的任务选择决定, 表9报告,在优化期间,Curator明确描述为不可能完成或无法完成的任务(因此没有选择相应的培训批次)。 这两个诊断类别重叠了8项任务:18项不可能和65项片状诊断共涉及75项独特任务。

blocks.en: Table 9: Tasks that the Curator deemed impossible or flaky at any point during optimization. Counts in the two diagnosis columns are not mutually exclusive.
blocks.zh: 表9:在优化期间,监管者认为不可能完成的任务或任何时段的片面任务。 两个诊断栏中的计算并不相互排斥。

blocks.en: We further manually classify each impossible diagnosis according to its primary cause. As shown in Table 10 , most impossible diagnoses arise from limitations of the execution harness or deployed environment, such as a missing feature, unavailable state, or unsupported action. Faulty tasks instead omit necessary information, impose an infeasible scope, or otherwise fail to specify a satisfiable objective. We separately retain speculative diagnoses and diagnoses later overturned by additional evidence.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步根据每个不可能的诊断的主要原因进行人工分类。 如表10所示,大多数不可能的诊断来自执行手段或部署环境的限制,例如缺少一个特征、没有状态或没有支持的行动。 错误的任务反而省略了必要的信息,强加了一个不可行的范围,或者没有指定一个可协调的目标。 我们分别保留了后来被其他证据推翻的推测诊断和诊断。

blocks.en: Table 10: Primary causes of tasks that the Curator deemed impossible during optimization. Diagnoses are counted if they occurred at any point in the task history.
blocks.zh: 表10:在优化过程中,库拉托尔认为不可能完成的任务的主要原因. 诊断如果发生在任务历史的任何时刻,则被计算.

blocks.en: We apply the same cause analysis to the 65 tasks that the Curator described as having flaky evaluation. Table 11 shows that faulty or underspecified tasks constitute the largest group, followed by harness or environment limitations, which can lead judges to accept an actor’s claim that it cannot complete the task. We also identify four tasks with a reliable, reproducible success behavior for which the evaluator occasionally produced false negatives by applying harsher or shifting criteria.
blocks.zh: 我们对Curator描述的65项任务进行了同样的原因分析,这些任务有片面的评价。 表11显示,错误或不明确的任务构成最大的群体,其次是利用或环境限制,这可以使法官接受一个行为者关于它不能完成任务的说法。 我们还确定了四项任务,其中包括可靠、可复制的成功行为,评估人员偶尔通过采用更严格或不断变化的标准,产生虚假的负面反应。

blocks.en: Table 11: Primary causes of tasks that the Curator deemed to have a flaky or broken evaluator. False negatives denote cases where reliable success behavior was sometimes rejected under harsher or shifting evaluation criteria.
blocks.zh: 表11: 库拉托尔公司认为评估员有故障或损坏的任务的主要原因。 假负数是指有时根据更严格或不断变化的评价标准拒绝可靠成功行为的情况。

blocks.en: Taken together, these analyses suggest that GEPA-Curator can identify tasks whose outcomes are unlikely to provide reliable optimization signals. Many of the tasks diagnosed as impossible or flaky are affected by inherent limitations of the execution harness or environment, or by faulty or underspecified task descriptions. By withholding these tasks from the corresponding training batches, GEPA-Curator prevents their potentially misleading outcomes from influencing those optimization steps.
blocks.zh: 总之,这些分析表明,GEPA-Curator可以确定其成果不大可能提供可靠优化信号的任务。 许多被诊断为不可能或片面的任务受到执行手段或环境的固有限制,或任务描述错误或不足的影响。 GEPA-Curator通过从相应的培训批次中排除这些任务,防止其潜在的误导结果影响这些优化步骤。

blocks.en: Importantly, an impossible or flaky diagnosis does not permanently retire a task. The diagnosis may be uncertain, and subsequent prompt updates or further actor exploration may reveal that a task previously considered impossible is solvable. The Curator therefore reconsiders skipped tasks in subsequent epochs.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,不可能或片面的诊断不会永久地使一项任务停止。 诊断可能是不确定的,随后的及时更新或进一步的行为者探索可能表明,以前认为不可能完成的任务是可以解决的。 因此,Curator在以后的时代重新考虑跳过的任务.

blocks.en:
To analyze this behavior, we divide the complete training epochs into three phases and measure the consecutive skipped epochs preceding each rerun. As shown in Table 12 , impossible tasks are deferred the longest, with their mean skip streak increasing from 5.50 to 8.75 epochs.
Mastered tasks are also deferred longer over time because repeated stable successes reduce the expected value of additional rollouts, although they are periodically revisited to detect regressions.
Flaky tasks are revisited more frequently to resolve uncertainty.
Thus, curation adjusts task frequency rather than permanently excluding tasks.
Furthermore, skip streaks generally increase as task histories accumulate, making the Curator more confident that rerunning a task at the current stage is unlikely to provide new information for prompt optimization.
blocks.zh:
为了分析这种行为,我们把完整的训练时代分成三个阶段,并测量每次重播之前连续跳过的时代. 如表12所示,不可能完成的任务被推迟的时间最长,其平均跳槽时间从5.50个增加到8.75个。
已掌握的任务也随着时间推移而推迟,因为一再取得稳定成功会减少额外推出的预期价值,尽管会定期加以重新审查以发现倒退。
为了解决不确定性,更经常地重新审视模糊的任务。
因此,校准会调整任务频率,而不是永久排除任务.
此外,随着任务历史的积累,跳转速度一般会增加,从而使Curator更相信,在目前阶段重新运行一项任务不可能为迅速优化提供新信息。

blocks.en:
While the Curator diagnosed 75 of the 1,581 training tasks (4.7%) as impossible or flaky at least once during optimization,
its effect on optimization is non-trivial.
Under uniform minibatch sampling, as in GEPA, a minibatch of 16 tasks contains at least one such task with probability 1 − ( 1 − 0.047 ) 16 ≈ 54 % 1-(1-0.047)^{16}\approx 54\% . Moreover, reflection is driven by failures, and these tasks fail far more often than the rest of the training set, assuming impossible tasks fail consistently and flaky tasks roughly half the time. As Appendix A.2 illustrates, even one or two such failures can elicit an overgeneralized mutation that passes minibatch gating while regressing a solvable task.
blocks.zh:
虽然Curator在1 581项训练任务中诊断出75项(4.7%)在优化期间至少一次是不可能或片状的,
它对优化的影响是非三角性的。

A selection is considered relevant when, at the time of selection, the history contains both a reliable success state and at least one noisy success state (e.g. evaluator leniency, contaminated environment state) and the Curator selects the reliable state. blocks.en:
We additionally evaluate AIME 2025 ( Balunovic et al., 2025 ) , IFBench ( Pyatkin et al., 2025 ) , HoVer ( Jiang et al., 2020 ) , and HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) using the benchmark programs, evaluators, data splits, and per-benchmark metric-call budgets released with the GEPA artifact ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) .
All optimized methods use the same Qwen3-8B ( Team, 2025 ) actor and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview ( DeepMind, 2026 ) Reflector under matched settings.
AIME ( Balunovic et al., 2025 ) uses 45 training and 45 validation problems, followed by five evaluations of its 30-problem test set; IFBench ( Pyatkin et al., 2025 ) uses 300 training, 300 validation, and 294 test instances; and HoVer ( Jiang et al., 2020 ) and HotpotQA ( Yang et al., 2018 ) each use 150 training, 300 validation, and 300 test instances.
Because these QA tasks provide simple reference answers, we apply task curation without selected-success evidence. To avoid bloating the Curator’s context, we only track the ten most recent history entries per task.
The Seed row reports the Qwen3-8B baseline published by GEPA, while the GEPA and GEPA-Curator rows report our matched runs.

blocks.en: GEPA-Curator matches or outperforms GEPA on three of four benchmarks, with modest gains on AIME and IFBench and a larger + 4.3 % +4.3\% gain on HoVer, while underperforming by 1.3 % 1.3\% on HotpotQA. The displayed benchmark scores average to 35.5 35.5 for the seed, 56.8 56.8 for GEPA, and 57.9 57.9 for GEPA-Curator. Thus, GEPA improves over the seed by 21.3 % 21.3\% and GEPA-Curator by 22.4 % 22.4\% , yielding a + 1.1 % +1.1\% advantage for GEPA-Curator. This corresponds to approximately 1.05 × 1.05\times GEPA’s optimization gain. The smaller improvement than on WebArena suggests that curation is less beneficial for structured QA, where evaluation already provides a relatively clean optimization signal.
blocks.zh: GEPA-Curator在4个基准中的3个基准上匹配或超过了GEPA,在AIME和IF Bench上略有增益,在HoVer上增益大于+4.3 %+4.3%,而在HotototQA上增益低于1.3% 1.3%. 显示的基准分数平均为种子35.535.5分,GEPA56.856.8分,GEPA-Curator57.957.9分。 因此,GEPA提高21.3%的种子,GEPA-Curator提高22.4%的种子,使GEPA-Curator获得+1.1%的优势。 这相当于大约1.05×1.05\的GEPA优化收益。 与WebArena相比,改进较小,这表明对结构化的QA来说,校准不太有利,因为评价已经提供了相对干净的优化信号.
